SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TO_CHAR(KEY_1) AS LEGACY_PO_NO, TO_CHAR(KEY_2) AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, TO_CHAR(KEY_3) AS LEGACY_INV_NO, TO_CHAR(KEY_4) AS LEGACY_INV_SEQ FROM KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'IVDOWN' AND IF_FLAG IN ('N','T') GROUP BY KEY_1, KEY_2, KEY_3, KEY_4
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'MOTR' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, '01' AS REVISION, NVL(PLANT,' ') AS PLANT, NVL(KEY_3,' ') AS LEGACY_IV_NO, NVL(KEY_4,' ') AS LEGACY_IV_SEQ, NVL(STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, NVL(KEY_1,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, NVL(KEY_2,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(ADD_DATE,' ') AS INVOICE_DATE, NVL(UNIT_PRICE, 0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(ITEM_QTY, 0) AS INV_QTY, NVL(ITEM_AMT, 0) AS ITEM_AMT, NVL(LEGACY_PR_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, NVL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK FROM V_KEP_IV, KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'IVDOWN' AND KEY_1 = LEGACY_PO_NO(+) AND KEY_2 = LEGACY_PO_SEQ(+) AND KEY_3 = LEGACY_INV_NO(+) AND KEY_4 = LEGACY_INV_SEQ(+) AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_INV_NO$' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_INV_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG IN ('N','T') ORDER BY KEY_1,KEY_2
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), KEY_5 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE 1=1 AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_INV_NO$' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_INV_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG IN ('N','T') AND DOC_NAME = 'IVDOWN'
